# Copilot instructions for Agent Durbar

This repository is spec-driven (GitHub Spec Kit) and shared by several people and agents. **The rules are in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)** (including "Working as a team": claim an issue, label what you open (one type, at least one `area:*`, `spec:NNN` for each spec it touches), branch `NNN-slug`, never push to `main`, review SLA about 30 minutes with `taking #N`, release `freeze` / `queue open`, `FINAL` settles ownership, worktrees not your main checkout, delete a branch only once its PR is `MERGED`; and "Keep docs in sync": update README, docs, spec tasks, a `changelog.d/` fragment (not `CHANGELOG.md`), the spec's `specs-index` block (not a `specs/README.md` row) and screenshots in the same PR, including every linked README and website screenshot that shows the changed screen (`npm run shots:docs`; one it cannot retake goes in its `NO_DRIVER` list with a reason), or open and assign an issue) and the project rules in [.specify/memory/constitution.md](../.specify/memory/constitution.md). Read both before changing anything, and read [docs/agent-notes.md](../docs/agent-notes.md) (what other agents learned; add to it when you learn something others would need), and run [docs/review-checklist.md](../docs/review-checklist.md) on your own diff as an adversarial self-review before asking for review. This file is only a pointer.
